safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports no previous similar episodes.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not mention whether the patient has had previous similar episodes.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether the patient has had prior similar reactions is clinically relevant for anaphylaxis risk stratification and anticipatory management (e.g., future epinephrine auto-injector prescribing and allergy referral). However, in this encounter the patient is already being treated as potentially anaphylactic with urgent escalation, so omission is unlikely to change immediate actions and mainly reduces documentation completeness for follow-up.
